title: Uganda Country Climate and Development Report: Executive Summary
temporal_coverage: Recent weather-shock exposure and climate-development projections through 2050 reported in 2025
methodology: CCDR executive summary reports six climate scenarios, two economic futures and modeled impacts with and without additional climate action.
limitations: Summary-level modeled results; migration estimate is not tied to a specific scenario in the inspected passage.

title: Updated Nationally Determined Contribution (NDC)
organization: Republic of Uganda, Ministry of Water and Environment
temporal_coverage: NDC actions for 2020-2030, with climate projections summarized through 2050
methodology: NDC update uses national risk and vulnerability assessments, the Third National Communication and climate/emissions projections.
limitations: Assessment ratings and national projections are summarized; rainfall projections carry wide uncertainty.

title: WASH National Adaptation Plan for Uganda (2026-2030)
organization: Republic of Uganda, Ministry of Water and Environment
temporal_coverage: WASH sector adaptation plan for 2026-2030; vulnerability analysis combines hazard and service indicators from cited datasets of varying dates.
methodology: Plan combines a WASH vulnerability assessment, hazard mapping and district service indicators.
limitations: Inputs include OPM's 2019 atlas; the plan is not an impact evaluation.

title: Conducting and Developing the Climate Change and Vulnerability Assessment (CCVA) Framework Report for Kampala Capital City Authority
organization: Republic of Uganda, Kampala Capital City Authority (KCCA)
temporal_coverage: Kampala assessment published June 2025; combines historical climate data, projections, GIS and stakeholder evidence across five divisions.
methodology: GIS and climate/social datasets, 400 household surveys, 20 focus groups and 30 interviews used purposive stratified sampling.
limitations: Vulnerable-area sampling is not population-representative; some local narratives cite older studies.

title: Pastoral conflict on the greener grass? Exploring the climate-conflict nexus in the Karamoja Cluster
organization: Rebecca Navarro, Lamis Saleh and Evelyne Owino; International Journal of Disaster Risk Reduction; abstract hosted by PreventionWeb
geographic_coverage: Karamoja Cluster, cross-border; country-level findings not disaggregated
temporal_coverage: Abstract describes conflict dynamics in 2018-2023 and an empirical environmental-variable analysis.
methodology: Abstract describes informant interviews and empirical linkage/prediction analysis using environmental variables and conflict data.
limitations: Only the abstract was readable; the journal full text was inaccessible, and cross-border cluster findings are not disaggregated for Uganda.
